Title: Public preview: Event Grid integration with AKS

Body.Content:
We are announcing the public preview of AKS as an event source for Azure Event Grid.

Azure Event Grid allows you to easily build applications with event-based architectures. After selecting an Azure resource to subscribe to, you simply provide an event handler or WebHook endpoint to send the event to and take action when you receive a subscribed event. 

With the public preview release of AKS integration with Azure Event Grid, you can now subscribe to the following events to automate AKS operations:

  • AKS event for a new Kubernetes version upgrade availability
  • AKS event for a new node Image version upgrade availability

Learn more.

Visit the product page.
